title: Kenyan Coconut Calamari
subtitle: with potato wedges, mayo & a Kachumbari salad
description: We bring you some bursting African flavours with these Kenyan-style fried calamari tubes, enrobed in desiccated coconut and served with potato wedges. This dish is completed by a lemon That Mayo sauce and a Kachumbari salad of tomato, red onion, cucumber, and fresh coriander.

instructions.title: COOK POTATO WEDGES
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the potato wedges on a roasting tray, coat in oil, ½ of the seafood rub and season. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and crisping up, shifting halfway.

instructions.title: LEMON MAYO
instructions.text: In a small bowl, mix the lemon zest with the mayo and seasoning until fully combined.

instructions.title: KACHUMBARI SALAD
instructions.text: In a salad bowl, combine the tomato chunks, sliced red onion, cucumber half-moons and ½ the chopped coriander. Squeeze in the juice of 1 lemon wedges and add 2 tbsp of olive oil. Season and toss to combine.

instructions.title: COAT SQUID
instructions.text: Whisk 1 egg in a shallow dish with 1 tsp of water. Prepare another shallow dish containing the flour, the remaining seafood rub, ¾ of the desiccated coconut and some seasoning. Pat the squid dry with paper towel. Coat the squid in egg mixture, then the flour & coconut mix, dusting off any excess.

instructions.title: FRY SQUID
instructions.text: When the potato wedges have 10 minutes remaining, place a pot over a medium-high heat with 4-5cm of oil. When hot, fry the coated squid for 3-5 minutes until golden and crispy, flipping halfway. Drain on paper towel and season.

instructions.title: PLATE
instructions.text: Plate up the crispy coconut calamari and potato wedges alongside the Kachumbari salad. Garnish with the remaining coriander, desiccated coconut, and lemon wedge. Serve with the lemony mayo for dunking. Delicious work, Chef!

chef_tip: You will notice the prep action for squid is 'quills removed'. The quill is found in the squid tubes and looks like a long piece of plastic. To remove it, simply grab it and pull it out slowly.
